2) Determining the shock response spectrum and effective duration of the test

① Overview. Based on the measured data of the equipment's working environment, the random vibration environment measured data and the extracted data, or the comprehensive statistical processing of these three types of data, the shock SRS and effective duration T are determined (see GJB 150.18A-2009 Annex).

②. For ease of use, the response should be measured in the equipment storage (chamber), and the shock input amount and the shock SRS and effective duration T should be derived under the conditions of using environmental-related measured data. The number of data extracted and the applicable test methods are:
a) For measured data, controlled by waveform method, through pulse shape to actually implement shock testing.

b) For measured data, by passing through a complex conjugate filter to synthesize the shock waveform, the effective duration T of this shock and the actual shock effective duration T are maintained, with duration T being the same, the waveform is similar in shape, and peak, trough and zero-crossing points are correlated.

c) Without measured data, but based on the shock response spectrum estimates, the shock waveform can be synthesized through complex conjugate filter superposition. The effective duration T determination should also take into account the equipment's inherent pulse characteristics.
d) Without measured data, the classic pulse shock waveform can be used to replicate the shock. Only when analysis cannot confirm that this pulse is a composite pulse can the classic pulse be used.

② With measured data, the effective duration T of the test is passed through the time history analysis of the typical shock time history, T, starting from the first significant point on the time history, consistently using the time history analysis method until reaching the base noise level in the time domain or frequency domain system. sections.text: The basic principle of applying and promoting nano-composite brush plating technology with traditional (or conventional) methods is similar. The difference is: during the brush plating process, the nano-particles in the composite medium (1-100nm) are deposited on the workpiece surface under the action of electric field force together with binding ions and other processes, settling on the workpiece surface to become a coating layer with enhanced nano-particle dispersion. The nano-particles and the metal achieve co-deposition and form a composite brush plating layer.

The characteristic of composite brush plating of nano-particles is related to the fact that after the nano-particles are added to the brush plating solution, the particle size must be different from traditional materials, and the properties need to be selected based on the requirements. The nano-particle characteristics are as follows, and the nano-particles can also be added to different material systems (body) to achieve different nano-particle composites. The brush plating composite nano-particle technology includes:

items: The nano-composite brush plating solution contains nano-scale insoluble solid particles. The presence of nano-particles does not significantly affect the plating solution properties (such as acid-base properties, conductivity, electrode potential, etc.) and the coating quality (such as coating adhesion, porosity, surface roughness).

Through nano-composite brush plating, the obtained composite brush plating coating is more dense, the particle size is smaller, the composite coating layer (fiber) structure is finer, the nano-particle grains are distributed in the metal base and the basic structure is mainly composed of micro-nano crystalline products.

Nano-composite brush plating coating has better wear resistance, higher temperature resistance, and equivalent or better comprehensive performance compared to conventional metal brush plating. Nano-composite brush plating is demonstrated to work at higher temperatures.

Based on the different nano-particle coating materials added, various tools with abrasion resistance and corrosion resistance can be obtained. The brushing of multiple types of nano-particle materials for different applications can improve this. The method reduces the cost, and achieves the best performance-to-price ratio of nano-brush plating composite materials for the selection of all ceramic coating material types.

In the same base metal nano-composite coating (several types), the different types of nano-composite brush plating solutions have corresponding brush plating processes for different nano-composite brush plating. The process can obtain different property nano-brush plating composite layers. Reference [31]: nano-brush plating electrolyte solution contains about 20g/L nano-particles. Nano-particle brush plating is performed according to the specified process treatment.

Especially for precision parts manufacturing in medium and small batches, nano-particle addition can greatly improve the coating layer performance, and can help solve many problems in the remanufacturing process.
